_comment: Site clip of the world1 package (27 Oct 2026): 4 s strips facing the far layer (lone peak, Arc, the Weeping Colossus in the cloud), camera tilted up so the horizon is in frame; the site clip cuts four of them together. Places from the longroad preview2 strips. A strip takes at most 60 frames (ReviewSheetSubsystem), so 60 frames over 4 s = 15 fps. fixed_step keeps it deterministic (not an FPS claim). Run with fresh-game/tools/diag/longroad/run_pkg_sheet.py inside the Unreal lock and the save guard. The area picker's DEV tag (top right) is cropped out at encode time.
